user.title: LiveWire account
user.description: Log in with the account of the LiveWire app.

device.title: Device UUID
device.description:
LiveWire only shares the battery and charging status of a motorcycle with devices paired with it. Home Assistant acts as such a device, identified by a device UUID.

Without pairing, the position, tire pressure, software versions and charging schedules are still available. Pairing can be done later by reconfiguring the integration.

menu_options.device_uuid: Use a device UUID that is already paired
menu_options.skip: Continue without pairing (no battery and charging data)

device_uuid.title: Paired device UUID
device_uuid.description: Enter a device UUID that is paired with your motorcycle, for example the one of the LiveWire app on your phone. The README of the integration explains how to find it.

pick_bike.title: Motorcycle
pick_bike.description: Choose the motorcycle to pair with.

pair_start.title: Pair with {bike}
pair_start.description:
Go to your motorcycle:

1. Switch the ignition on and wait for the display.
2. Make sure it is not in propulsion mode and not charging.
3. It needs cellular reception.

Then submit, and the motorcycle shows a pairing code on its display.

pair_code.description: Enter the code shown on the display of {bike}.

not_paired.title: {bike} is not paired
not_paired.description:
The device UUID of Home Assistant is not paired with {bike}, so its battery and charging status are not available.

To pair it, go to **Settings** > **Devices & services** > **LiveWire**, choose **Reconfigure** in the menu of the entry, then **Pair with my motorcycle**.
